items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: We were re-oist. And when we got through there, we were putting them up, you know.

ctx.x: I remember if it could have been a buffet or Selmer or... No. Is it a French clarinet, do you think? It was made in Paris. Made in Paris. Yeah. Maybe Pencil Moller or something like that. Well, it might have been a buffet, but you don't know.

Yeah, it could be. Yeah, no, I never did notice the name on it. Yeah. Of course the name be on the barrel of it, you know. Yeah. I never did notice. I remember a fella had a clarinet. He bought it. And it was cold that night. We were re-oist. And when we got through there, we were putting them up, you know. Yeah. He pulled it like this, half into one of these coins. Oh, yeah. To wipe it out. Yeah. Yeah, it made out of this tough... Shammy skin they used sometimes. Yeah, like glass, you know, but it wasn't glass.…
But the rag got stuck in the floor.
